data.description:
# Intake Brief: Startup-ramp window vs actual readiness

## Goal

As an operator running herdr/agent workers, I want the post-restart startup
ramp to stop rejecting `chat/completions` as soon as the proxy's local
backends are actually ready for dispatch, and to use a short safety ceiling
otherwise — so a restart no longer imposes a multi-minute client blackout.

## Context

The ramp opens at `PROXY_START_TIME` (set in the lifespan handler,
`proxy/proxy/server.py` ~L1158-1163) and rejects **every** new chat request
until `server.startup_ramp.max_seconds` elapses (default **180**,
`proxy/config.yaml` L848-855; gate at `proxy/proxy/ui.py` ~L971-1013; config
resolution in `proxy/proxy/mode.py` ~L148-200).

The window is fixed and completely decoupled from backend readiness.

### Evidence (2026-09-20, `/var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log-2026-09-21_00`)

- `23:55:40.94` local — `PROXY_START_TIME` set; ramp window opens (ends `23:58:40.9`).
- `23:55:44.46` — `llama-server is ready` and `Router preload complete: ['embeddings', 'code']` — backends ready ~3.5 s into the window.
- `23:55:46.6` → `23:58:19.3` — 32+ `Startup ramp: deferring chat request` 503s across sessions.
- Session `herdr-1789944904-2662453-21495`: first request `22:55:16Z`, first successful completion `22:59:19Z` → **4m03s blackout**, of which ~**176 s** occurred *after* the backends were already ready.

The ramp fires on **every** process start (not only mode-switch restarts),
because `PROXY_START_TIME` is set unconditionally in the lifespan handler.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1**: The ramp clears as soon as the local-backend readiness condition is
  satisfied (llama-server ready **and** router preload complete), not only when
  `max_seconds` elapses.
- **AC2**: `max_seconds` is reduced to a short safety ceiling (target <= 30 s)
  and acts as a hard cap: if readiness never arrives, the gate still lifts at
  the ceiling so chat requests are never blocked indefinitely.
- **AC3**: The readiness signal used by the gate is the same signal the rest of
  the proxy uses for dispatch readiness (single source of truth; no divergent
  or duplicated "is it up?" check).
- **AC4**: Tests (extend `proxy/tests/test_startup_ramp.py`) cover:
  ready-early -> gate clears early; never-ready -> gate holds only until the
  ceiling; disabled / `max_seconds: 0` -> no gating.
- **AC5**: Non-chat endpoints remain unaffected; `enabled: false` and
  `max_seconds: 0` remain full opt-outs.
- **AC6**: `proxy/config.yaml` comments updated to describe the
  readiness-driven behaviour; `/skill:test` full suite green.

## Out of scope

- Client-side `Retry-After` honoring (tracked in ContextHub as
  `WL-0MU9Z7L8X00117BI`).
- Restricting the gate to locally-dispatched requests (separate work item).

## Related

- discovered-from: `LP-0MU9ZXFQS0023DXT` (startup ramp implementation)
- relates-to: `LP-0MU9Z7O8M0053Y0K` (ramp end time in 503 body)
